## Functions

### `SiteFooter`

```ts
SiteFooter(props: SiteFooterProps): Html
```

The site's foot: brand and tagline, columns of links (four across,
two on a tablet, one on a phone), and a bottom bar with the legal line
and social icons. Links are muted until hovered, so the page ends
quietly.

## Types

### `SiteFooterColumn`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `links` | `{ label: string; href: string }[]` | yes |  |

### `SiteFooterSocial`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | yes | The accessible name — "Acme on GitHub". |
| `href` | `string` | yes |  |
| `icon` | `Html` | yes |  |

### `SiteFooterTag`

The root element: `div` when something around it is already the `<footer>`.

- `"footer"`
- `"div"`

### `SiteFooterProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | `Html` |  | The mark and name, first column. |
| `tagline` | `string | Html` |  | A line under the brand. |
| `columns` | `SiteFooterColumn[]` | yes |  |
| `bottom` | `Html` |  | The legal line in the bottom bar — "© 2026 Acme". |
| `social` | `SiteFooterSocial[]` |  | Icon links in the bottom bar. |
| `newsletter` | `Html` |  | A form slot beside the brand — a newsletter sign-up. |
| `tag` | `SiteFooterTag` |  | Pass `"div"` in a layout's `footer` slot: the layout already wraps it in a `<footer>`, and one may not hold another. @default "footer" |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### In a layout's footer slot

The layout already wraps the slot in a `<footer>`, so this one renders a `<div>`.

```ts
SiteFooter({
  tag: "div",
  columns: [{ title: "Company", links: [{ label: "About", href: "/about" }] }],
})
```

```html
<div class="site-footer">
  <div class="container site-footer__inner">
    <div class="site-footer__top">
      <div class="site-footer__columns">
        <nav class="site-footer__column" aria-label="Company">
          <h3 class="site-footer__title">Company</h3>
          <ul class="site-footer__links">
            <li>
              <a class="site-footer__link" href="/about">About</a>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </nav>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### The site's foot

```ts
SiteFooter({
  brand: html`
    <strong>Acme</strong>
  `,
  tagline: "Invoices your customers pay on time.",
  columns: [
    {
      title: "Product",
      links: [{ label: "Pricing", href: "/pricing" }, { label: "Changelog", href: "/changelog" }],
    },
    { title: "Company", links: [{ label: "About", href: "/about" }, { label: "Careers", href: "/careers" }] },
    { title: "Legal", links: [{ label: "Privacy", href: "/privacy" }, { label: "Terms", href: "/terms" }] },
  ],
  bottom: html`
    © 2026 Acme Inc.
  `,
  social: [{ label: "Email Acme", href: "mailto:hello@acme.example", icon: Icon("mail", { size: 16 }) }],
})
```

